deployability_code_evidence.truth_boundary: The code can bind PostgreSQL and exposes a deployable Python web entrypoint, but no real PostgreSQL server or hosting target is claimed until external binding and readback succeed.

deployment_evidence.note: The prior SQLite-only deployability gap is closed in code. The remaining blocker is external: no production/preview target with a real PostgreSQL binding and newsroom secret is evidenced by the connected deployment surface.

social_single_writer_preflight.cutover_rule: Do not enable vNext direct apply until a production runtime is live and independently healthy; then fence the legacy scheduled direct writer atomically before the first vNext apply. Preserve legacy state as read-only history and rollback evidence.

public_host_verification.note: Shadow WSGI projection is PASS, but no deployed vNext target has yet been independently read back.

non_blocking_media_gap.policy: Missing user-owned assets does not block controlled-live because editorial-card/no-visual fallback is valid; user-owned photos remain migration/media debt and must retain ownership provenance when imported.

blocking_requirements_before_controlled_: Create or bind a preview/production hosting target for the LOCAL NEWS OS vNext site application without changing public DNS.
Provision and bind a real PostgreSQL database through LOCAL_NEWS_RUNTIME_DATABASE_URL.
Bind a private LOCAL_NEWS_NEWSROOM_TOKEN of sufficient entropy to the hosting target.
Deploy merge commit 92cf4e7a20290c29a539b1bf8614788d9bc5c7a8 or a validated successor to the isolated target.
Run real deployment preflight, /healthz and canonical-route parity against that target.
Fence the legacy scheduled Facebook/Instagram direct writer atomically immediately before first vNext direct apply.
Perform one low-risk controlled-live story publication and independent public/social readback with rollback armed.
intervention_scope: Provide or authorize the external hosting target, PostgreSQL resource and runtime secrets. No remaining code redesign or editorial decision is required before deployment preflight.
